_comment: 平台输入框 DOM 选择器 — 用于一键填入功能。支持分国家站点精确匹配。content.js 按 hostname 匹配：shopee.co.th → shopee_th → shopee 降级。可通过 https://api.postboost.ai/selectors 热更新。

tiktok.title: input[name='productName'], input[placeholder*='product'], input[placeholder*='Product']
tiktok.caption: div[data-contents='true'][contenteditable='true'], div.DraftEditor-editorContainer div[contenteditable='true'], textarea[name='description'], div[contenteditable='true'][aria-label], textarea.caption-input, textarea[placeholder]

shopee.title: input[name='name'], input[data-testid='product-name-input'], div.product-name input, input[class*='product-name'], input[maxlength='120']
shopee.caption: textarea[name='description'], div.product-description textarea, div[class*='description'] textarea, textarea[data-testid='product-description'], div[contenteditable='true'][data-placeholder], textarea[placeholder]

lazada.title: input[name='name'], input[id*='product-name'], input[class*='product-title'], input[maxlength='120'], input[data-field='name']
lazada.caption: textarea[name='description'], div.description-editor div[contenteditable='true'], div[class*='description'] textarea, div[contenteditable='true'], textarea[placeholder]

shopee_th.title: input[placeholder*='ชื่อสินค้า'], input[name='product_name'], input[name='name']
shopee_th.caption: textarea[placeholder*='รายละเอียด'], div[contenteditable], textarea[name='description']

lazada_th.title: input[placeholder*='ชื่อ'], input[name='productTitle'], input[name='name']
lazada_th.caption: textarea[placeholder*='รายละเอียด'], textarea[name='description'], div[contenteditable]
